claims.content: The objective of the R² procedures is to ensure that only the JU having the best positional data available is reporting the track on the interface. Any JU may report, through operator action only, on a previously reported emergency point when that JU has additional or more current information on the point.

scope_contract.goal_statement: The objective of the R² procedures is to ensure that only the JU having the best positional data available is reporting the track on the interface. Any JU may report, through operator action only, on a previously reported emergency point when that JU has additional or more current information on the point.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: The C2 JU currently holding reporting responsibility transfers it to another JU that has better positional data; the other JU assumes reporting responsibility for the point/line/area/track, and the transferring JU ceases reporting it with a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message.
scope_contract.start_boundary: The C2 JU holds reporting responsibility for a reported point, line, area, or track, and another JU has better positional data available.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The other JU assumes reporting responsibility for the entity and the transferring JU has ceased reporting it, completing the transfer.
in_scope_actions: Transfer reporting responsibility to the JU with the best positional data
Assume reporting responsibility for the reported point, line, area, or track by the receiving JU
Cease reporting and transmit J7.0 (ACT = 0) when the transferring JU relinquishes responsibility
excluded_adjacent_actions: Initial assignment of reporting responsibility to the first JU that reports a contact
Retention of reporting responsibility while the originator remains active
Post-transfer track data management or downstream reporting procedures
variant_dimensions: Type of reported entity: point, line, area, or track
Emergency point vs other reported point
Reason for transfer: additional or more current information / better positional data

missing_aspects: Explicit evidence supporting the transfer of reporting responsibility for 'points' and 'lines' (as opposed to tracks) based on 'best positional data', rather than just 'additional or more current information' via operator action.

claims.content: C2 JU
A Subsurface contact is already being reported on the interface by a JU that holds reporting responsibility for a specific Track Number.

Another JU has better positional data available for that reported entity: for an emergency point, it has additional or more current information on the point; for a common track, its local TQ at the time of transmission exceeds the received TQ by 2 or more.
No other JU is currently reporting the same contact using the same Track Number (unless a J7.0 Drop Track message has been received or two consecutive periodic J3.4 updates have not been received).
The C2 JU holding reporting responsibility for a real-time track receives a remote track report with a Track Quality (TQ) greater than its local TQ.

missing_aspects: Trigger via operator action for previously reported emergency points with additional or more current information is not supported by any valid evidence card.

The claim adds the interpretation that the higher TQ indicates 'better positional data available' and implies the actor is specifically a 'C2 JU', neither of which is explicitly stated in the source text. The source only specifies the condition (TQ > local TQ) and the action (relinquish R2).

claims.content: The C2 JU holds reporting responsibility for a real-time Air, Surface (Maritime), or Land (Ground) track and retains that responsibility until it is relinquished.

Another JU transmits a remote track report for the same common track; because its local Track Quality (TQ) at the time of transmission exceeds the received TQ by 2 or more, it assumes R² for the track.
The C2 JU receives the remote track report in which the remote TQ is greater than its local TQ.
The C2 JU relinquishes R² for the track.
The C2 JU ceases reporting the track because it has relinquished R² to the other JU.
The C2 JU does not transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track Report message for the track, because the track is no longer being reported due to a shift in R².

missing_aspects: The cited cards EC-MF-009 and EC-MF-004 describe the condition under which a JU *relinquishes* responsibility upon receiving such a report, but do not explicitly state the step of 'receiving' the report as an isolated action. The claim should be rewritten to reflect the consequence defined in the evidence.

claims.content: Diverges from Step 3: If the remote track report has TQ equal to the local TQ and comes from a JU whose Source TN is greater than the local Source TN, the JU relinquishes R² for the real-time track.

Diverges from Step 3: Instead of receiving a remote track report with greater TQ, if a JU receives a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message on a locally held track, it assumes R² at the next opportunity to transmit the track if local reporting eligibility remains and a remote report has not been received on that track.

Diverges from Step 3: Instead of receiving a remote track report with greater TQ, if a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message is received from the FJU for a PU, RU, or other IU, the C2 JU assumes R² of the IU if it has correlated local sensor data.

Diverges from Step 3: Instead of receiving a remote track report with greater TQ, if no J2 PPLI message is received for 40 to 60 seconds, the C2 JU assumes R² of the IU (including C2 and non-C2 JUs and forwarded PUs/RUs), in accordance with the reporting rules for a real-time track, when it has correlated local sensor data.

Diverges from Step 3: Instead of receiving a remote track report with greater TQ, if a J2 PPLI message (other than J2.0) is received with the NPS Indicator set to Inactive or Conditional Radio Silence, the C2 JU assumes R² of the IU when it has correlated local sensor data.

Diverges from Step 3: Instead of receiving a remote track report with greater TQ, if a JU receives a J2 PPLI message (with the NPS Indicator set to Inactive, Conditional Radio Silence, or TDS Failure) from a JU that has R² of a locally held track, it may assume R² at the next opportunity to transmit the track if local reporting eligibility remains and a remote report has not been received on that track.

Diverges from Step 3: Instead of receiving a remote track report with greater TQ, if the Geodetic Position Quality in a J2 PPLI message is set to 0, the C2 JU assumes R² of the IU when it has correlated local sensor data.

Diverges from Step 2: For a reported point, if no periodic update is received for three consecutive update intervals, another IU may, by operator action only, assume R² for the point using the same Reference TN.
Diverges from Step 2: For a ballistic missile launch point, the latest IU to report on the point has R² for the point.
Diverges from Step 2: For a non-real-time track with the TQ field set to 0, a JU without R² assumes R² for that track when the track is locally updated by a new nonreal-time report.

missing_aspects: Alternative transfer flows specifically for lines or areas are not supported by the available evidence cards.

An operator-action takeover of a previously reported emergency point based directly on additional or more current information is not explicitly supported; EC-AF-007 covers no-update timeout and EC-AF-008 covers ballistic missile launch point only.

The claim specifies 'C2 JU' while the evidence card refers generally to 'A JU'. Unless 'C2 JU' is defined as the specific actor in this context elsewhere, the claim should align with the evidence's generality or be restricted to the supported scope.
The claim specifies 'C2 JU' while the evidence card refers generally to 'A JU'. The claim should align with the evidence's generality.

The claim uses the term 'non-real-time' (hyphenated) while the evidence card uses 'nonreal-time' (unhyphenated). While semantically identical, strict adherence to source terminology suggests using the unhyphenated form found in the evidence.

claims.content: Diverges from Step 2: If the assumed R² entity is a ballistic missile track, the unit assuming R² need not assume R² for the associated launch point; the unit no longer holding R² on the ballistic missile track may continue to report the launch point in accordance with the transmit/receive rules.
Diverges from Step 2: If the reported entity is a subsurface track, it shall not be correlated with IUs. Exit: no correlation with an IU is performed.

Diverges from Step 3: If the remote report is a J2 PPLI correlated with a track for which another C² JU has R² and the TNs are the same, and the Geodetic Position Quality in the PPLI message is set to 0, the receiving JU accepts the surveillance track and discards the PPLI message. Exit: the local surveillance track is accepted and the PPLI is discarded.

Diverges from Step 2: If position or other data in a PPLI meet decorrelation criteria, the PPLI and local track data shall be decorrelated; the C² JU then initiates a new surveillance track report with locally held data using a new track number, and reports both the PPLI Track Number/Identity Indicator and IFF/SIF Indicator fields as 'No Statement'.

missing_aspects: No evidence supports exception handling specific to line or area entity transfers.
No evidence supports a documented recovery/exit after PPLI decorrelation beyond initiating a new surveillance track report.
Explicit confirmation that the exit state 'R² for the launch point is not transferred' and 'the previous unit may continue reporting it' are supported by the source text.
Explicit support for the 'Exit' clause stating 'a new surveillance track report is initiated under a new track number'.

claims.content: The remote JU with the superior TQ is now the reporting JU for the track; the C2 JU has relinquished R² and ceased reporting the track.
The latest JU to report a point has R² for that point.
For a ballistic missile track, the remote JU has assumed R² and is the new reporting entity, because its local TQ exceeded the received TQ by 1 or more.
R² for a ballistic missile track does not automatically transfer R² for the associated launch point; the unit no longer holding R² may continue to report the launch point.
After the C2 JU has ceased reporting an inactive IU because it returned as an Active IU with the same Track Number, a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track Report message is not transmitted.

missing_aspects: No evidence card supports postconditions specific to line or area entity transfers.
No evidence card explicitly states the postcondition for an operator-action transfer of an emergency point based on additional or more current information; EC-PO-000 covers reported points generally.
